description: This file defines a PHP trait named UserRoleManagerTrait, which provides methods to access user role management services within the OrangeHRM system. The trait includes methods to retrieve a user role manager and a helper object, utilizing dependency injection via a service container.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Returns an instance of either AbstractUserRoleManager or BasicUserRoleManager from the dependency injection container.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerHelper
methods.description: Returns an instance of UserRoleManagerHelper from the dependency injection container.
